Map Reading Style Scale

Instructions:  Below are descriptions of how the guide read the map. Use the following scale to rate each.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. The guide used grid references.

_____2. The guide asked where we wanted to go.

_____3. The guide measured distances with the scale bar.

_____4. The guide checked that we agreed on the route.

_____5. The guide did not use grid references.

_____6. The guide did not ask where we wanted to go.

Reverse Code Items 5 & 6

Technical Factor:  1, 3, 5

Shared Factor:  2, 4, 6
